reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for orchestrating parallel agent conversations by binding each conversation to an isolated Git worktree and branch, with sidebar management and Git mutation tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话与独立 Git 工作树及分支的绑定，以支持并行智能体协作和工作树管理。
summaries.en: Binds DeepSeek Harness conversations to isolated Git worktrees and branches for parallel agent collaboration and worktree management.

capabilities: Creates, switches, and deletes Git branches
Reads repository status, branches, and worktree bindings
Creates and manages workspaces and conversation bindings
Can force-remove worktrees or force-delete branches
Provides same-origin host routes without authentication when loopback binding is used
